info.title: linkedin_conversions (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: LinkedIn Conversions API (CAPI). A server-to-server integration that lets you send conversion events directly to LinkedIn without relying on browser-based tracking. Requires Authorization: Bearer {access_token} and LinkedIn-Version header. Use this API to send conversion events such as purchases, sign-ups, and other valuable actions that happen on your server.

post.description: Transmit a server-side conversion event to LinkedIn via the Conversions API. Events are matched to LinkedIn members through hashed user identifiers (email, first name, last name, title, company, country). The conversion parameter must reference an existing conversion action configured in LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

200.description: {success, event: {id, account, conversion, email, amount, currency_code}, event_id}

requestBody.description: Body: {account (required, string â€” LinkedIn Ads account ID), conversion (required, string â€” conversion action name or URN), email (optional, string â€” user email for identity matching), first_name (optional, string), last_name (optional, string), title (optional, string â€” job title), company (optional, string â€” company name), country (optional, string â€” two-letter country code), linkedin_first_party_ads_tracking_uuid (optional, string â€” first party cookie ID from li_fat_id), lead_id (optional, string â€” LinkedIn Lead ID from Lead Gen Forms), amount (optional, number â€” monetary value of the conversion), currency_code (optional, string â€” ISO 4217 currency code, default USD), conversion_happened_at (optional, string â€” ISO 8601 timestamp when conversion occurred), event_id (optional, string â€” custom event ID from advertiser for deduplication)}

ConversionEvent.description: A conversion event submitted through the LinkedIn Conversions API.

account.description: The LinkedIn Ads account ID associated with this event.

conversion.description: Name or URN of the conversion action being recorded.

email.description: User's email address, used to match the event to a LinkedIn member.

company.description: Name of the user's employer or company.

country.description: Two-character ISO country code for the user.

amount.description: Monetary amount associated with the conversion.

currency_code.description: Currency denomination as an ISO 4217 code (e.g., USD).

conversion_happened_at.description: Date and time at which the conversion took place.
